name: Kick DVR
description: Kick plugin with real-time stream DVR rewind (independent from official Kick).
author: MarianQQQ (FUTO upstream)

authentication.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0.6778.200 Mobile Safari/537.36

authenticationDesktop.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

settings.name: Live Stream DVR (Rewind)
settings.description: Allows rewinding live streams back to any point from the start (adds ~15s delay to live edge)

settings.name: HTTP
settings.description: Use the standard HTTP client for requests

settings.name: Request Retries
settings.description: Retry failed HTTP requests up to 3 times before falling back

settings.name: HTTP Impersonation
settings.description: Use browser impersonation (HttpImp) to bypass bot detection

settings.name: Stream Impersonation
settings.description: Use browser impersonation when playing streams

settings.name: Verbose notifications
settings.description: Show toast notifications for HTTP request details (useful for debugging)

17: Fix: Safer username extraction from URLs;
Fix: Proper URL generation while sharing previous streamed videos;
Fix: Deeplinking previous streammed videos from Kick's website;
18: Improvement: When playing livestreams show featured streams as recommendations. Otherwise show previous streams from the channel;
19: Improvement: retry all requests at least 3 times;
22: Fix: reflexion issue logging exceptions in desktop;
24: Fix: some VODs not playing when opened from a channel page (channels with capitals or spaces in their name);
Fix: channel search with special characters;
25: Fix: VOD links shared from Grayjay opening a not-found page on kick.com;
Fix: VOD links copied from kick.com not opening;
26: Feature: Real-Time Stream Rewind / DVR (rewind live streams to any moment from start);
Feature: Setting to toggle between Full DVR and Low-Latency edge.
27: Fix: Authentication not capturing cookies (removed obsolete broadcasting/auth completionUrl);
Fix: Robust thumbnail parsing in HomePager.
28: Rename: Kick DVR with independent UUID (isolated from official Kick plugin);
Improvement: Clean login flow directly on /login without element conflicts.
29: Fix: Trigger Kick login modal via button[data-testid='login'] on https://kick.com (Kick has no standalone /login page).
